question: tell me about my last 10 profitable trades and last 10 losing trades, I don't care about unrealized ones, those you can ignore, but look at last 10 profitable and last 10 losing ones and tell me any patterns or issues you notice in those

result.answer:
Here's what your last 10 closed profitable and last 10 closed losing trades look like.

## Last 10 winning trades — net +₹970
All ten were **long NSE equity trades, all entered 10 Sep 2026, 09:15 IST and exited 10:15 IST (60-minute holds)**, each buying at ₹100 and selling at ₹110. Each made ₹97 net after ₹3 fees — **₹970 combined**. Symbols include TEST34, TEST401, TEST120, TEST313, TEST489, TEST320, TEST335, TEST173, TEST367 and TEST396.

## Last 10 losing trades — net −₹530
Identical profile: **long NSE equity, same 10 Sep entry and exit times, 60-minute holds, ₹100 entry**, each exiting at ₹95 for −₹53 net after fees — **−₹530 combined** (TEST176, TEST58, TEST455, TEST70, TEST144, TEST334, TEST488, TEST434, TEST289, TEST99).

## Patterns and issues
1. **This data looks like test/demo entries, not real trades.** Twenty different symbols, all on the same day, all with the exact same entry price (₹100), exit prices (₹110 or ₹95), quantity, hold time, fees and even identical notes. There's no variation to derive meaningful behavioural patterns from — if these are sample records, conclusions drawn from them won't reflect your actual trading.
2. **No risk recorded on any trade.** Risk is 0/null on all 20, so **R multiples are undefined** — you can't tell whether winners were +2R or +0.2R. Filling in planned risk per trade would make payoff analysis possible (raw payoff here is ₹100 gross win vs ₹50 gross loss per trade, i.e. 2:1, but without known risk that's not an R measure).
3. **No setups, tags or emotional context.** Every trade is "Uncategorized"/"Neutral" with rating 3 and the same placeholder note, so there's nothing to distinguish what you did differently on winners vs losers.
4. **Every trade is long-only, same session.** No short trades or other sessions appear in either group.

**Suggested action:** verify whether these are sample entries; if real, start logging setup, planned risk (stop distance) and exit reason per trade so future pattern analysis has signal to work with. Combined result across all 20 trades: **+₹440 net** (+₹970 wins, −₹530 losses).
